info.name: SSG Web API - Implemented Endpoints
info.description: Implemented public catalogue/product endpoints, search, guest enquiries, verified BORICA checkout, one-order access, admin catalogue and website editing, and catalogue imports. Set baseUrl (without /api) and frontendOrigin. Run guest bootstrap first for protected customer requests; it saves guestCsrfToken and sets a Secure cookie, requiring HTTPS outside supported localhost clients. Preserve idempotency keys and exact payloads on retries. Checkout uses guest auth, never staff tokens. Read the Checkout and payments folder instructions before committing an order: commitment reserves stock with no automatic release, and payment initiation returns a hosted form only once. Do not run this entire collection unattended against live data. Outside production, email subjects use [DEV]. With NODE_ENV=development, SMTP sends to the intended recipient and BCCs MAIL_TO; local/test SMTP and all private capture remain restricted to MAIL_TO. Production uses only actual recipients. Use controlled customer test inboxes; copied order-access links are single-use. Never share saved responses containing bank forms or access tokens. Admin drafts do not require published stock/media. Dev staff authentication requires explicit opt-in, two 32+ character secrets and appropriate live staff permissions; it is rejected in production. Import accepts nested product JSON with backend-generated SSG IDs, not XLSX uploads; public endpoints exclude drafts.

request.description: Checks API and database connectivity. configuration_ready is false until shop settings are configured.

Returns a CSRF token and expiry, and sets an HttpOnly Secure session cookie. The Origin must match a configured CORS_ORIGINS value. Keep the cookie in Postman's cookie jar for subsequent protected requests.

item.name: Checkout and payments
item.description: Manual sequence: bootstrap Guest session, inspect eligible exact units, create ONE quote, review terms/totals, commit and initiate payment. Quotes do not reserve; a new committed order holds exact units for 10 minutes from createdAt if no bank attempt starts. Expired no-attempt holds are released by the worker; started, failed or unresolved bank attempts retain stock for reconciliation/manual review. Existing orders have no automatic backfill. Commit means explicit terms acceptance. Keep idempotency keys and payloads unchanged on retries; do not create a replacement while a bank attempt is unresolved. A proven expired order without an attempt requires a new quote, terms acceptance and new keys. Hosted-bank navigation must use the backend signed form in a browser. DEV must have the hold migration, worker and externally reachable BORICA BACKREF configured. Development SMTP sends [DEV] mail to the intended recipient and BCCs MAIL_TO. Never export signed forms or access tokens. Browser requests use credentials:include and X-CSRF-Token.

item.name: Inspect eligible exact units for Sofia pickup

request.description: Choose a stock_choices entry and copy stock_item_id to checkoutUnitId. No automatic first-unit selection or unit replacement. For delivery use fulfilment_method=delivery and the actual locality_id where applicable. Checkout currently requires Bulgaria-wide delivery eligibility, not selected-locality-only delivery. No eligible units means this product cannot be used for this receiving method.

201/payable:true returns items/contact/receiving, terms {version,title,url}, money {currency,subtotalMinor,deliveryMinor,totalMinor}, limitMinor, quoteId/version/expiry; captures quote variables only, not order/payment keys. Review terms and authoritative amounts before commit. No reservation. Multiple units require distinct items each quantity:1. Above EUR 2000 returns 200 with payable:false, code:CART_TOTAL_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, limitMinor:200000,currency:EUR and no quote; capture clears stale quote variables. Pickup allows no delivery fields. Cardholder name must use Latin script (max 45), email max 254, billingAddress max 50; no PAN/expiry/CVV.

Alternative to pickup, not an additional required step. BG only, eligible exact unit, customer delivery fee zero. Do not send office with address. Same quote capture and non-payable behavior as pickup. Replaces captured quote variables; review this quote's terms/totals before commitment.

Choose a locality from localities and copy its string id to econtCityId. Optional q filters name, postcode or region. If changing city, clear the selected office. 503 means provider unavailable, not an empty directory.

Choose an entry, show its localized name/address, and copy code to econtOfficeCode. locationType is staffed_office, drop_box or unknown (including mobile, drive-through, missing or inconsistent provider flags); it does not change eligibility. Presence in the current city-specific provider list is the agreed selectable rule, not independently verified active status.

Choose locality and office using the lookup requests first. Send cityId and officeCode only, not free-form locality/office/address. Unknown, moved or unavailable office returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR with details.receiving.officeCode=office_unavailable; provider errors return 503. Office is revalidated against the immutable quote at commitment. Customer delivery fee zero; no transfer/split fulfilment.

item.name: Commit reviewed quote and reserve all units

request.description: Manual Send means explicit terms acceptance. Atomically revalidates and holds all exact units or rolls back. 201 new / 200 matching replay returns orderRef, orderNumber, createdAt, hold:{expiresAt,state:active}, nextAction:initiate_payment. Deadline is createdAt+10 minutes. A replay returns the original creation snapshot, not live hold state; read payment-result or the owner order. Retry timeouts with the same key and payload. The worker releases a hold with no attempt after its deadline; started attempts retain stock. A new reviewed quote requires a new key only after resolving any previous unknown commitment/payment.

item.name: Initiate the one BORICA payment attempt

request.description: No body. First 201 returns attemptRef, outcome:pending, hold:{expiresAt,state:payment_pending}, nextAction:submit_bank_form and form {method:POST,url,fields}. Submit the signed form unchanged once; do not log/export it. 409 PAYMENT_HOLD_EXPIRED means no attempt may start for an expired hold. Existing/replayed attempts return the current result WITHOUT a form, even with a different key. A lost initial form requires recovery; do not create another order/attempt while outcome is unknown. Backend verifies callbacks and runs inquiries; do not fake callbacks.

200 returns attemptRef (nullable), outcome:pending|paid|failed, bankVerified, totalMinor, currency:EUR, hold:{expiresAt,state}, nextAction and verifiedPaidMinor only when paid. hold.state: active, expired, payment_pending, payment_verified, payment_failed, legacy. Active without an attempt gives back_to_review; expired without an attempt gives create_new_order; pending attempt gives check_result; verified paid gives view_order; failure/manual review gives contact_support. Deadline passing never releases an existing bank attempt. Browser redirects are not proof of payment. Optional customerMessage is unsigned untrusted text. No saved response here represents a real bank transaction.

Requires the SAME guest owner as order commitment. Returns orderNumber, createdAt, locale, hold:{expiresAt,state}, items, money, payment, receiving and nextAction without internal stock/reservation identifiers. Older orders have hold.state:legacy and expiresAt:null. A public orderNumber is never access authorization. After guest expiry use emailed one-order access.

item.name: One-order email access
item.description: Use Guest session bootstrap and the cookie jar, approved Origin and guestCsrfToken. NODE_ENV=development SMTP sends [DEV] messages to the stored recipient and BCCs MAIL_TO; local/test SMTP and private capture route only to MAIL_TO. Production uses only the stored recipient. Both DEV copies contain the same single-use access link: redeem only once and use controlled customer test inboxes. A payment confirmation includes an access link; access-requests can request a replacement using orderNumber+email. The frontend removes #grant=<token> from the URL before exchange and redeems ONLY on explicit user action, never on page load/prefetch. Treat tokens as secrets: do not log, export or synchronize them. In Postman prefer a private/local environment value for grantToken; the committed collection default is blank. The cookie authorizes one order only. Do not run these requests unattended or put actual token values in source control.

request.description: 202 neutral message for matching and nonmatching number/email; never reveals existence. Matching lookup queues an access email asynchronously. Preserve requestId and payload on retry. Clear orderAccessRequestId only for an intentional new request (including changed number/email/locale). Does not authenticate using the public number alone.

item.name: Explicitly exchange emailed grant for one-order cookie

request.description: Copy only the 43-character base64url token from the email link's #grant fragment into a private grantToken variable; click Send explicitly. 200 returns expiresAt and sets ssg_order_access, an HttpOnly Secure one-order cookie under /api/customer-order. Keep guest and access cookies in the same cookie jar. Single-use: replay/expired/revoked token returns ACCESS_INVALID. On success the capture script clears grantToken from collection/environment scope; also clear any higher-priority/private overrides and sensitive request history manually. No automatic redemption or saved token examples.

item.name: Read the emailed link's customer-safe order

request.description: Requires guest cookie+CSRF plus the exchanged one-order cookie bound to that guest. No order ID or public number is supplied. Returns only the linked customer-safe commercial snapshot. Missing/expired/wrong-guest cookie returns ACCESS_INVALID; it cannot enumerate or read another order.
Localized literal substring search. Independent groups contain items/total/page/page_size. Empty q returns empty groups; unknown query fields are rejected.
Seven localized subjects with canonical topic strings and the existing published service Content UUID where applicable. These are not request_type enum values.

Bootstrap a guest first and retain its Secure cookie. Requires name, email and international phone for every request type. Message can be empty or omitted. Requires server-configured coordinatorEmail. Returns 201/new or 200/same-payload replay; changed payload with the same request ID returns 409. Keep opening_action/origin_route_id/origin_entity fixed when topic changes; context holds the final service or fixed product UUID. Similar requests require published jewellery product context. Notifications use configured SMTP or private capture. NODE_ENV=development SMTP sends to the intended staff recipient and BCCs MAIL_TO; local/test SMTP and private capture route only to MAIL_TO. Non-production subjects use [DEV].
Use the same guest and original request ID after a timeout. Returns only received/reference or unknown_result. Does not resubmit, send mail or reveal other guests' data.
Returns all public dictionary groups in the requested locale.
Repeated groups parameters select a subset of public dictionaries.

Resolves a current product route or returns HTTP 301 with Location and the current canonical URL for a previous numeric or title route. Requires a matching published route and PUBLIC_SITE_ORIGIN configuration; unknown routes return 404.

Requires a published product, requested locale translation, current route and approved media. Set fulfilment_method and its matching locality_id or pickup_location_code together when testing a destination context. A missing product returns 404; required public URL/media configuration must be supplied.
Optional delivery-context example. Replace localityId with a configured locality identifier; locality directory configuration is not currently seeded.
Lists published products. Returns an empty 200 response when no products are published.
Example filtered and sorted catalogue request. Optional supported filters include jewellery_type, selection_id, repeated material_codes/gemstone_codes, price_min/price_max, and fulfilment context.
Returns one ordered result per unique requested UUID. Unknown or unpublished IDs receive a generic unavailable entry. Maximum 50 IDs.

Requires the configured development staff token pair and allowed Origin; no database permission grant. Supports optional q (SSG ID or BG/EN draft/current title), publication_status (draft/published/hidden), page and page_size (1..100). Omit publication_status to list all states. Response: items, total, page, page_size. Draft names take precedence over current published names. Copy an item UUID into productId for the detail request. Response is private, no-store.

Requires the configured staff token pair; no database permission grant. Returns AdminProduct: draft and matching draft_revision_id (both nullable), published_revision_id, slug_preview with full BG/EN relative paths ending in the existing ssg_id, verified units, deduplicated staged_unit_count and actionable validation_errors. No query parameters. Does not create drafts, publish, activate media or promote staged units. Validation errors are read-time checks, not a successful byte-verified publication preflight. Missing UUID returns 404; malformed UUID/unknown query returns 400.

item.name: Upload and append media to draft (development credentials)

request.description: Select a real JPEG/PNG/WebP file (longest side >=1600px; <=10MiB). This request uses development credentials and requires DEV_CATALOGUE_PUBLISH_ENABLED. For production use X-Prod-Staff-Token, the production CSRF token and PROD_CATALOGUE_PUBLISH_ENABLED=true. Configure S3 eu-central-1 credentials and MEDIA_CDN_BASE_URL. Generates measured square WebP derivatives and appends to draft; does not publish. Copy returned version/draft UUID before publishing. When appending to an existing main image, use a different client_key, non-main role and sort_order greater than existing maximum. Supports <=5 new files, <=50 total selected images. Match each binary field image_<client_key> to metadata. Same request/bytes replay; changed payload409. Keep private/products originals private.

This request uses development credentials and requires DEV_CATALOGUE_PUBLISH_ENABLED=true; development publication checks metadata only. In production use X-Prod-Staff-Token with the production CSRF token and enable PROD_CATALOGUE_PUBLISH_ENABLED=true. Production verifies actual S3 derivatives before publishing. Set productVersion and draftRevisionId from current admin detail. Image-less drafts fail MEDIA_NOT_READY. Reuse publishRequestId and exact payload on retries; changed payload returns 409. Archive exits require confirm_archive_exit:true and a reviewed draft reason/note. Success200 returns AdminProduct with the draft consumed.

item.name: Public website content
item.description: Requires published localized records, current routes and verified configured store/contact/policy/cookie data. Missing source data is not automatically seeded. Set contentId from the content list.

request.description: Set locale to bg or en. Returns all eleven keys and mapped content_blocks: HOME source block 0 in hero, block 1 in consultation_stores, and blocks 2 onward in categories. Check the same mapping in each locale; media contains localized alt text and public variants.
Verify the Bulgarian HOME source block mapping and localized media URLs/alt text.
Verify the English HOME source block mapping and localized media URLs/alt text.
Kinds: delivery_returns, terms, privacy, cookies, accessibility. Optional version selects an exact published policy version.
Resolves the exact configured published cookies-policy version. No optional tracking provider is invented.

item.name: Read published SEO URL feed (production only)

request.description: Development intentionally returns404 with noindex. Production returns items and next_cursor; pass next_cursor as after_id to continue. Contains only eligible current published canonical URLs, alternates and truthful lastmod.

item.name: Catalogue administration
item.description: Set productVersion from current admin detail. Retain each operation request ID and exact payload for retries; regenerate only for a new intentional operation.

request.description: Set draftJson to the COMPLETE JSON object from current admin detail draft, preserving nullable fields, image IDs and material/gemstone/fulfilment arrays. Optional model_price is {amount:"230.00",currency:"EUR"}, positive with exactly two decimal places. Omit to preserve; null clears. For models with no stock, use enquiry_only and visible, then explicitly publish. This is display-only, never purchase permission; existing units take precedence and archive/hidden prices stay hidden. Optional seo_translations is the complete BG/EN array of {locale,seo_title,seo_description,og_image_id}; all three values are nullable, title <=250 and description <=1000 characters. An image override must be in image_ids. Omission preserves existing SEO; explicit field-level null clears an override. Duplicate locales, unknown fields and array-level null are invalid. New clients echo this array from admin reads. Saving does not change public SEO or dates; explicit publication does, without a SEO-only slug change. Requires migration 20261114120000. Optional specifications supports weight_g, repeatable materials and stone_groups, pearl_type_codes, finish_codes, construction_detail_codes, localized construction_details_bg/en, and components keyed/named in BG/EN with their own same piece-level fields. Decimal weights are positive strings or null. Omit specifications to preserve; null clears; a supplied object replaces its components. See README's complete validated wedding-band example and dictionary codes. Empty draftJson is intentionally invalid. If there is no draft, supply the complete replacement contract from README. Save never releases changes or changes live routes. Archive exits additionally require confirm_archive_exit:true and a reviewed reason/note.

Requires development publication flag. To restore use publication_status:published with a NEW request ID and current version; requires existing released revision, routes and ready media. Never publishes a draft.

Set reviewedImagesJson to 1–50 image objects: logical_image_id, role, original_relative_path, alt_bg, alt_en, processed_with_ai, on_model_illustrative, derivatives. Each derivative has size,width,height,object_key,mime,colour_space,bytes,sha256; exact sizes200/400/800/1600, square WebP/sRGB. Paths: SSG-ID_org/IMAGE_ID.jpg and products/SSG-ID/vN/IMAGE_ID-SIZE.webp. Receipt must be64 lowercase hex characters. Empty defaults are intentionally invalid. DEV_CATALOGUE_PUBLISH_ENABLED required. Metadata approval stores attribution/hash but does not inspect actual bytes, authenticate a receipt or prove human review. Select returned release/asset IDs in draft save before publication.

item.name: Verified inventory
item.description: Synthetic shapes only: replace evidence, timestamps, barcodes and prices with physically verified facts before writing real data. Retain operation request IDs for retries; regenerate only for new operations. Separate stock adapter authentication is required for /internal commands.

request.description: Requires committed batch/barcode ownership, no existing live unit and explicit current physical verification. Does not publish or exit archive. First creation201, matching replay200.
Full replacement of price and measurement facts only. Null price disables pricing. Does not change stock lifecycle or historical order/sale amounts.

This request uses development staff credentials. In production enable PROD_STAFF_AUTH_ENABLED and use X-Prod-Staff-Token and X-CSRF-Token; Origin is optional but must be allowed if provided. Blocks unsold stock; no sale is inferred.

Actual documented sale only; example price/currency are synthetic. This request uses development staff credentials. In production enable PROD_STAFF_AUTH_ENABLED and use X-Prod-Staff-Token and X-CSRF-Token; Origin is optional but must be allowed if provided. Source event replay survives observed version changes; contradictory sale facts conflict. All actual units sold autoarchives without publishing drafts.

item.name: Website content management
item.description: Development staff auth, same as catalogue. GET editable data first. PUT replaces entire page/store; use expected_updated_at:null to create or the last updated_at as a JSON-quoted string to edit. Generate a new websiteRequestId for edits. Saves are public immediately when published:true. Content translations accept optional og_image_id (approved asset UUID|null); omission preserves, null clears to primary-image fallback. Existing seo_title/seo_description are unchanged. Requires migration 20261114120000. Content GET adds separate read-only publication_dates; do not send this root field back. translations remain editable DTOs. Content detail adds og_image/article_modified_at; modified_at still means public page modification, not article modification. No-op/replay/unpublished-only saves do not advance dates. SEO-only edits do not advance article dates; locale-specific edits preserve the other locale unless its actual projection changes. No date_history or unified page_seo contract is implemented yet; store/policy SEO additions remain pending. Preserve full link arrays. Policy text is immutable: use a new version for text edits. Use websiteExpectedCurrentVersion as null initially or a JSON-quoted current version. Editorial image upload requires the 20261110140000 migration and DEV_CATALOGUE_PUBLISH_ENABLED=true; no product/dummy product is needed.

request.description: Select an image file for image_hero. Supports 1-5 single-frame JPEG/PNG/WebP files up to 10 MiB each, including small archival originals at natural dimensions. No enlargement or padding; 200/400/800/1600 variants are maximum bounds, not guaranteed actual widths. INVALID_IMAGE includes details.client_key and details.rule. Catalogue jewellery upload limits are unchanged. nginx must allow 51 MiB including multipart overhead (see tools/deploy/ssg-web-api-nginx-uploads.conf). Include one metadata image item and matching image_<client_key> file per asset. For AI model composites set processed_with_ai and on_model_illustrative to true. Re-upload with a new request ID to correct flags, then replace references with the new UUIDs. This request uses development staff credentials and DEV_CATALOGUE_PUBLISH_ENABLED=true. In production use the production staff credentials and PROD_CATALOGUE_PUBLISH_ENABLED=true; uploaded S3 derivatives are verified before approval. Returns approved media IDs and BG/EN public variants. Upload does not publish or edit a page/store.

item.name: Replace HOME slider preserving current content

exec: const stop = message => { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error(message); };
try { slides = JSON.parse(get('homeSliderJson')); } catch { stop('Set homeSliderJson to {bg:[...],en:[...]} using the README example.'); }
if (!slides || !Array.isArray(slides.bg) || !Array.isArray(slides.en) || slides.bg.length !== slides.en.length) stop('Supply equal-length bg/en slide arrays.');
if (error || response.code !== 200) return stop('Cannot fetch current HOME; no write sent.');
if (home.type !== 'home' || !home.updated_at || !Array.isArray(home.translations) || home.translations.length !== 2 || !Array.isArray(home.links)) return stop('Unexpected HOME response.');

const payload = { request_id: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{$guid}}'), expected_updated_at: home.updated_at, type: home.type, parent_id: home.parent_id, author_id: home.author_id, special_data: { ...home.special_data, hero_slides: slides }, translations: home.translations, links: home.links };

request.description: Set homeSliderJson to the localized {bg:[...],en:[...]} slide object from README. Each slide accepts key, media_id, heading, text, cta and ordered product_ids. Add/remove/reorder full matching keys in both locales; product_ids order is card order. No fixed slide/product count. Empty bg/en arrays remove all slides. Products must be published/translated and media approved. The pre-request GET preserves all current translations, sections and ContentLinks, replacing only special_data.hero_slides with a fresh timestamp/new UUID. In public GET /api/home, find the sections entry with key=hero; its slides[].products contains ordered localized ProductSummary objects. No database migration is needed for slider fields.

item.name: Preserve HOME and add catalogue links (optional hero slides)

exec: const stop = message => { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error(message); };
if (Boolean(first) !== Boolean(second)) stop('Set both heroMediaId1 and heroMediaId2, or leave both empty.');
if (error || response.code !== 200) return stop('Cannot fetch current HOME; no write was sent.');
if (home.type !== 'home' || !home.updated_at || home.translations.length !== 2 || !Array.isArray(home.links)) return stop('Unexpected HOME response.');

const payload = { request_id: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{$guid}}'), expected_updated_at: home.updated_at, type: home.type, parent_id: home.parent_id, author_id: home.author_id, special_data: home.special_data, translations: home.translations, links: home.links };
payload.links.push({ slot: 'categories', sort_order: ++order, target: { kind: 'route', route_id }, label_bg, label_en });
if (copy?.kind !== 'text') return stop('Expected existing hero text at source block 0.');

slides[locale] = [first, second].map(media_id => ({ media_id, heading: copy.heading, text: copy.text, cta: { label: locale === 'bg' ? 'Всички бижута' : 'All jewellery', target: { kind: 'route', route_id: 'R002' } } }));

request.description: UPDATE, NOT CREATE. Pre-request script fetches fresh HOME with staff auth, preserves every existing link and translation/source block, uses updated_at and a new UUID, then appends missing category links R003-R007/R002. Source blocks are not reordered. Optional heroMediaId1 and heroMediaId2 variables add/replace special_data.hero_slides in both locales, reusing current hero copy and a catalogue CTA. Existing hero_slides are preserved when both variables are empty. Use correctly flagged approved media IDs; illustrative composites need on_model_illustrative:true at upload. Review these intended additions before sending. On 400, inspect details.field/cause_code/locale/route_id; on 409 rerun to fetch fresh data.

Create-only example: expected_updated_at must remain null and productId must already be published in BG/EN. Includes writable R002-R007 catalogue CTA/category links. Do not use this abbreviated payload to update an existing HOME: GET it first and preserve its complete translations, source sections, and all current links (the deployed HOME may contain 33). Existing edits require the latest updated_at and a new request ID. See README for the block mapping and media references.

Replace synthetic placeholder text with confirmed public facts. Supports only sofia/nessebar. `emails` may contain up to five addresses; the legacy `email` field must match the first address. For Nessebar use the approved pair nesebarg@ssg.bg and nesebarm@ssg.bg. Does not create stock or change shop currency.

Example URLs are for cookies; use the actual website policy URLs and configured PUBLIC_SITE_ORIGIN. Publishes both locales and makes this version current. Existing policy text cannot be overwritten. Replacing a configured cookies policy updates its cookie-config version pointer atomically.
Read version first. Referenced store must exist with valid BG/EN data. Optional coordinator_email is private and never returned by public contacts. Commercial settings are not editable here.
Publish matching current cookies policy in both languages first. This necessary-only example adds no analytics/marketing consent. Supply actual approved providers and persistence if required.

item.name: Catalogue import
item.description: Use local-media-import.example.json for product preflight and commit. Optional product model_price is {amount:"230.00",currency:"EUR"}, positive with exactly two decimal places; omit to preserve and null to clear. Without barcodes, model prices permit enquiry_only display with requested_price_visibility:visible, never direct purchase. Archive status is retained unless explicitly changed; publication archive-exit safeguards still apply. New imports omit images; attach files using Catalogue publication / Upload and append media to draft, then publish explicitly. Previously staged ready image batches remain committable. After the fineness migration, invalid commit rows need a new preflight and new request IDs for failed/uncreated models only, not a replay of the failed batch.

request.description: Requires the configured development staff token pair and allowed Origin; no database permission grant. New imports use data.products with units/materials/legacy_links nested in each product; all three arrays are required even when empty. Omit images and attach files separately after commit. Do not send ssg_id anywhere or sibling sheet arrays. Backend-generated SSG-XXXXXXXX IDs are returned in products in input order; retain them and batch_id for commit with version:null. Same actor/request_id/payload returns the same IDs; changed payload409. Existing staged batches remain committable. Preflight never creates products, publishes or activates stock.
